decisions.reason: As a close extension to the firm's web shop and CMS-related offer, this template fits existing technical knowledge and can be improved through the firm's own R&D, so management would likely retain it despite some niche-market risk.
A responsive website template is closely related to the firm's established hosting and website services, making it easy to understand customer feedback and refine within the current business.
Premium customer support directly reinforces the firm's core agency-focused service model and uses capabilities it already has in abundance, so it is very unlikely to be withdrawn.

A software version management tool builds on the firm's existing management-tool and technical support competences, and in-house R&D increases the chance that early lessons can be turned into commercial improvements.

An online tool for creating data processing contracts is relatively far from the firm's core hosting and operational expertise, so even with internal R&D the firm is less able to interpret market feedback and is more likely to redeploy resources to nearer products.
